title: Hook Telemetry Envelope
description: Common envelope a marketplace plugin hook (producer) emits to a consumer-set sink. Versioned by schema_version. Per-hook detail lives in `data`, described by data/<hook>.schema.json keyed on the `hook` value. Contract-doc only: no validator is wired (see README).

schema_version.description: SemVer version of this envelope contract.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC instant the hook finished. True UTC (TZ=UTC) — the Z suffix is not a local-time lie.

hook.description: Producer hook id, e.g. "markdown-format". NOT Claude Code's hook_name (event:matcher). Keys data-schema discovery: data/<hook>.schema.json.

hook_event.description: Free string naming the triggering event (PostToolUse, SessionStart, ConfigChange, WorktreeCreate, ...). Deliberately not an enum.

status.description: Universal execution outcome. Documented values: ok | error | skipped | blocked. Deliberately a documented open string, NOT a closed enum (mirrors hook_event) — the value set grows, and a closed enum would reject a future value, contradicting the tolerate-unknown rule. Consumers MUST treat an unrecognized value as a catch-all, never hard-fail. See README "status".

duration_ms.description: This hook's own runtime in milliseconds. NOT Claude Code's aggregate total_duration_ms.

session_id.description: Optional since 1.1. The Claude Code session the hook ran in, copied verbatim from the hook payload's session_id. Present when the producer's payload carried a plain id; a sink files the row per session on it and falls back to data.session_id from producers on 1.0.

prompt_id.description: Optional since 1.1. The payload's prompt_id (Claude Code v2.1.196+), which matches the prompt.id attribute on the session's real OpenTelemetry events: the documented join between a local envelope and the same turn's OTel stream.

tool_use_id.description: Optional since 1.1. The payload's tool_use_id on tool events, finer than prompt_id: one per tool call.

agent_id.description: Optional since 1.1. The payload's agent_id when the hook ran inside a subagent.

data.description: Per-hook payload; always present (at minimum {}). Shape described by data/<hook>.schema.json. Generic sinks ignore this and consume only the common fields.
